title: Consumer outreach (KG project, sarcoma labs, advocacy) + shortlist
context: A real downstream consumer is what turns the corpus into a delivered outcome, so this task opens outreach to the KG project, sarcoma labs, and advocacy orgs and compiles a shortlist. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. No commitments are fabricated; verifiedNeed stays false until a consumer confirms use (partner-013).
objective: Compile a consumer/partner shortlist and open at least one outreach thread.
acceptanceCriteria: Outreach shortlist compiled (ewsr1-fli1-knowledge-graph project, sarcoma labs, advocacy orgs) with a contact channel per candidate.
At least one outreach thread opened, with status recorded.
No commitments fabricated; verifiedNeed remains false until a named consumer confirms (partner-013).
